title: Levi's Men's Quilted Hooded Bomber, Olive (S)

comparisons.notes: Men's Levi's Quilted Midweight Coat with hood and drawcord, olive in stock at $99.99; same hooded quilted style as the Woot LM5RP520 bomber

writeup: Levi's hooded quilted bomber in olive, men's size small, is $37.99 on Woot. It's a midweight 100% polyester shell with a drawcord hood and two lower pockets. Boscov's charges $99.99 for the same quilted hooded style, and Kohl's lists it at $96 but is sold out, so this is about 62% less. Woot caps it at 10 per customer.
